title: French Kale Salad
description: A simple French-inspired salad featuring curly kale, crunchy walnuts, and a tangy vinaigrette.

ingredients.name: Kale
ingredients.amount: 2 cups, stems removed and discarded, leaves torn into bite-sized pieces

instructions: 1. In a large bowl, massage the kale with your hands for about 2-3 minutes to help soften it.
2. In a small bowl, whisk together the red cider vinegar, olive oil, and honey until well combined.
3. Pour the dressing over the kale and toss to coat.
4. Sprinkle the chopped walnuts over the top of the salad and serve immediately.
